# BDSubMerge 1.0.2

BDSubMerge 1.0.2 promotes the tested 1.0.2 beta series to a stable Windows and Linux release.

## Highlights

- Added a native Linux x86_64 desktop package alongside Windows x64. Both packages include native
  GUI smoke tests, visual evidence, SHA-256 files, and only BDSubMerge's root `LICENSE` at the
  package root.
- Refined the resizable subtitle mapping workspace with compact adjustable columns, chapter-only
  boundary cells, full-width timeline labels, mouse-wheel zoom, user boundary editing, batch
  offset controls, and inline per-subtitle offset spin boxes.
- Manual boundary and row-level offset changes now invalidate stale preflight results without
  automatically rerunning preflight after every adjustment. Offset spin buttons also repeat while
  held.
- Playlist duration, item count, chapter count, and recommendation score sort by numeric value.
- Improved Simplified Chinese warnings and error explanations while retaining diagnostic codes and
  original technical messages.
- Added an About menu with the project homepage and `@YuSaZh` author identity, simplified the title
  bar to `BDSubMerge`, and renamed the implementation task document to `ProjectPlan.md`.
- Fixed the final layout issues from beta testing: inline offset arrows remain inside their column,
  and long output target paths use the full visible cell width before being elided.

## Packages

- `BDSubMerge-1.0.2-windows-x64.zip`
- `BDSubMerge-1.0.2-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
- Matching SHA-256 files are included for both archives.

**Full Changelog**: [v1.0.1...v1.0.2](https://github.com/YuSaZh/BDSubMerge/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2)
